chunks: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: Among the happiness of a man is a righteous son.

key_terms.السعادة: Happiness, felicity — encompasses both worldly contentment and spiritual well-being
key_terms.الولد الصالح: The righteous son — one who embodies piety, moral uprightness, and obedience to God

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about a righteous son being a source of happiness?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) identifies having a righteous son as one of the sources of a man's happiness in this world. This teaching was transmitted through Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) via a mursal (broken) chain, reflecting the deep emphasis in Shia tradition on the virtuous upbringing of children as a fundamental blessing. In the context of early Islamic society, a righteous offspring represented not only personal joy but also continuity of faith and good deeds.
